tools.name: clanker_launch_status

tools.name: pumpfun_top_traders
tools.description: Cached on-chain wallet results and a modeled follower result; never exhaustive. By default lists only wallets with a positive simulated follower result and positive realized PnL; pass false to include every eligible wallet. pump.fun wallets ranked by on-chain results. Past results are no guarantee.

tools.name: pumpfun_trader_profile
tools.description: Cached wallet metrics, sample exclusions and recent trades; refreshes within a bounded RPC budget. pump.fun wallets ranked by on-chain results. Past results are no guarantee. Copying is late by design: you buy after the wallet you copy, usually at a worse price, and can lose everything you put in.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
